label: Boulder

county_election_office.name: Boulder County Clerk & Recorder, Elections Division (Clerk Molly Fitzpatrick), 1750 33rd Street, Boulder 80301

zip_caveats: This place is the City of Boulder, but Boulder ZIP codes reach past city limits (Gunbarrel in 80301 is mostly unincorporated, and 80301, 80302, 80303 and 80304 all take in county land). If you live outside city limits, you will not see the mayor, City Council or city measures 2J, 2K, 2L and 2M. Everyone in Boulder County votes on CO-2, CU Regent CD-2, the county offices, the county judges, 1A, 200, 201 and Front Range rail 7A. State House splits Boulder roughly at Broadway: east of Broadway (plus Gunbarrel and the CU campus) is HD-10, where only one candidate is running; west of Broadway is HD-49. The whole city is in State Senate District 18, which is not up in 2026, so most Boulder voters have no state senate race. SD-15, SD-17 and HD-12 appear on other Boulder County ballots; we could not confirm their exact boundaries, so they are listed only in case a Boulder-ZIP address outside the city falls in them. RTD: Boulder is in Director District O (an open seat); if your address is in another RTD district, you have no RTD race this year. No school board race or school district measure is on the 2026 Boulder County ballot. Check your exact ballot with the GoVoteColorado sample ballot lookup.
